title: Whose Facts Count? A Culturally Responsive Audit of LLM Evaluation Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a six-dimension culturally responsive (CR) rubric to audit LLM benchmark questions for Western/Global North referents, individualistic framing, requirements for single indisputable truths, and the marginalization of Global South contexts and oral knowledge traditions.

Comparing the language distribution of user prompts in the LMSYS Chatbot Arena dataset against International Telecommunication Union (ITU) estimates of global internet user demographics to quantify the overrepresentation of English.
